description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间
description.en: The end of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created.

description.zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

description.zh:
排序顺序。取值： 
1. CreateTimeAsc： 按照创建时间顺序排列
2. CreateTimeDesc： 按照创建时间逆序排列
description.en:
The order that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

1. CreateTimeAsc: sorts the jobs by creation time in ascending order.

2. CreateTimeDesc: sorts the jobs by creation time in descending order.

description.zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为20，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间
description.en: The beginning of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created.

The state of the job.

Valid values:

- Init: The job is submitted.

- Success: The job is successful.

- Fail: The job failed.
